description: Registered 23 May 1978 as CCCP-87955; delivered 1 July 1978 to the Aktyubinsk Higher Civil Aviation Flying School; re-registered UN-87955 in 1992-93; passed into the ownership of the Military Institute of the Air Defence Forces; withdrawn 1993 and stored at Aktobe; offered for sale from 15 June 2017 through Kazspetsexport of the Kazakh Ministry of Defence and bought by a private entrepreneur; moved by road from Aktobe to Oral on 16-17 September 2017; a children's cafe was planned inside; year_built from the registration date; no separate build date is stated
